direction.problem: A body/root reverses direction under a planted support while a coupled secondary mass still carries pre-reversal momentum. The secondary channel must cross and overtravel after the root has changed velocity sign, then earn its own catch before settling into the new trail.

pocket_rule: WHEN THE ROOT REVERSES, THE TRAILING MASS DOES NOT TELEPORT ITS VELOCITY SIGN. PLANT THE BODY, LET OLD MOMENTUM OVERTRAVEL, THEN CATCH THE SECONDARY CHANNEL INTO THE NEW TRAIL.

noodle_queen.judgment: The root gets to change its mind before the trailing mass does. The secondary channel crosses the body, overruns the new direction, yanks a real brace out of the torso, then settles without a cheap rewind.
